svg.title: FG-I4: Tangent: a periodic graph with gaps
svg.desc: Branches are split at denominator zeros. A later stage compares copies separated by period π. Static design sketch showing two selected states. Read the learning plan for the full interaction.
svg.text: FG-I4 / Tangent: a periodic graph with gaps
ANNOTATED DESIGN SKETCH · selected states, not a production screen
Inspect sin θ divided by cos θ.
The ratio rises towards the gap at π/2.
At π/2 itself, the ratio is undefined.
Branches are split at denominator zeros. A later stage compares copies separated by period π.
